chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa ibn Imran al-Nakha'i narrated to us from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir. He said:

Al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: Whoever establishes the obligations of God, abstains from what God has prohibited, perfects his wilaya to the Ahl al-Bayt of the Prophet of God, and dissociates himself from the enemies of God, Mighty and Majestic, then let him enter from whichever of the eight gates of Paradise he wishes.

key_terms.أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ الثَّمَانِيَةِ: The eight gates of Paradise, a well-established Islamic concept
key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ: Ahl al-Bayt — the household of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW)
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةَ: Wilaya — spiritual loyalty, devotion, and guardianship toward the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.تَبَرَّأَ: Tabbarra — dissociation and disavowal of enemies of God and Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.فَرَائِضَ اللَّهِ: The obligatory duties ordained by God, including ritual worship and moral imperatives
key_terms.مَحَارِمَ اللَّهِ: The things forbidden by God, the boundaries He has set

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for entering Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) enumerates four conditions for entering any of the eight gates of Paradise: fulfilling divine obligations, avoiding what is forbidden, maintaining perfect loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt, and dissociating from the enemies of God. This hadith, transmitted through Abu Basir, presents wilaya (devotion to the Imam's household) alongside worship and moral conduct as equally essential conditions for salvation, reflecting the Shia theological principle that faith without attachment to the Ahl al-Bayt is incomplete.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. `Imran al-Nakha`i narrated to us from his uncle al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Nawfali from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Abi Hamza from Abi Basir. He said:

Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said: Whoever establishes the obligations of Allah, abstains from what Allah has prohibited, perfects his wilaya to the Ahl al-Bayt of the Prophet of Allah, and dissociates from the enemies of Allah will enter from whichever of the eight gates of Paradise that he wishes.
